say:1:1830166001:1.text: It is, thanks to my father, Acton.
say:1:1830166001:1.source_cn: 多亏我那位好父亲——哀克顿老爹，确实很吵。
say:1:1830166001:1.male: It is, thanks to my father, Acton.
say:1:1830166001:1.female: It is, thanks to my father, Acton.

say:2:1830166002:1.text: He's a dyed-in-the-wool opera fan. Say one word to him, and he'll answer with a line from some play.
say:2:1830166002:1.source_cn: 他还是生者的时候就最喜欢看歌剧，这个爱好到现在也没戒掉...
say:2:1830166002:1.male: He's a dyed-in-the-wool opera fan. Say one word to him, and he'll answer with a line from some play.
say:2:1830166002:1.female: He's a dyed-in-the-wool opera fan. Say one word to him, and he'll answer with a line from some play.

say:3:1830166003:1.text: Since Senea arrived in Novaris, he's been visiting the Seasong Theater almost every day.
say:3:1830166003:1.source_cn: 后来耀光帝国的歌剧明星——塞涅来到了诺珐斯，他恨不得每...
say:3:1830166003:1.male: Since Senea arrived in Novaris, he's been visiting the Seasong Theater almost every day.
say:3:1830166003:1.female: Since Senea arrived in Novaris, he's been visiting the Seasong Theater almost every day.

say:4:1830166004:1.text: Good thing my mother didn't turn Graveborn after she died, or she'd be giving my father an earful over this nonstop.
say:4:1830166004:1.source_cn: 幸好我母亲死后没有变成亡灵，不然非为了这件事和他大吵一...
say:4:1830166004:1.male: Good thing my mother didn't turn Graveborn after she died, or she'd be giving my father an earful over this nonstop.
say:4:1830166004:1.female: Good thing my mother didn't turn Graveborn after she died, or she'd be giving my father an earful over this nonstop.

say:5:1830166005:1.text: ... Actually, having my father around isn't all that bad. At least he keeps me from missing my mother too much.
say:5:1830166005:1.source_cn: ……或许吵一点也有好处。至少我不会经常想起我母亲。
